confidenceSemantics.claimed_unverified: Stated without verification, or tests honestly report no suite / not green.
confidenceSemantics.owner_confirmed: Stated directly by the owner (Black Lansky).
confidenceSemantics.verified: The lineage record passed slice verification on verified_at (record content verified), or a test run / live check passed on the stated date.

rules.rule: Every JSON/JSON-LD file in scope must parse (any extension, including extensionless id/ files).
Every @id is an absolute https URI under https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-learn/.
Entity files under id/ have @id exactly matching their file path (id/<type>/<slug>).
Every provenance entry has claim, value, source @id, dateCreated, dateModified, version, confidence, status.
confidence is one of: verified | owner_confirmed | claimed_unverified | incomplete.
'verified' requires a dateModified and a source @id. Verified = actually verified on that date by that source.
New relationships use only the 16 controlled terms in graph/ontology.jsonld. Legacy graph.json edges are grandfathered via rel_legend only.
Every internal @id cited in ai-index.json, entity-index.json, the ontology, and entity relationships resolves to a file in the tree.
Every id/product/* entity carries the schemas/product.json required fields including lineage[].
Every provenance block carries the schemas/provenance.json required fields.
